title: Thomas Mann's birth chart
metaDescription: Thomas Mann's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 15.3° Gemini. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Moon stands at 20.6° Cancer, in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 15.3° Gemini. That falls in the second decan, 10°–20°, sub-ruled by Venus in the classical scheme — a air sign read through a mutable season.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Day to day the chart speaks through Mercury in Cancer (9.1°), Venus in Taurus (16.6°), Mars in Capricorn (2.4°): a mind that absorbs before it argues, taste for the substantial and the lasting, drive that grinds rather than flares.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Mars and Neptune — a trine holding at 0.3°. A trine runs downhill — the talent that never announces itself because it never had to. Behind it, the Sun sextile Uranus at 3.1°, and Saturn square Pluto at 3.4° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, four sit in a sign it has an opinion about. The Moon in Cancer at 20.6° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Venus in Taurus at 16.6° is in domicile; Mars in Capricorn at 2.4° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Saturn in Aquarius at 26.1° is in domicile. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 4 in earth, 3 in air, 2 in water, 1 in fire by element, 5 fixed, 4 cardinal, 1 mutable by modality. An earth emphasis reads as patience with material reality — slow hands, durable results. Mars and Jupiter were retrograde. Saturn changed direction during the day, so its motion is left open.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Cancer for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.5° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 20.6°.
